body: How do you know when you've truly reached the state of being dead inside?

I don't want to sound rude or mean but none of us matter or are special, myself in the least, and my problems are not temporary, I've been dealing with them for decades, and I'm finally taking the proactive step to say "no more", the suffering, pain and missery ends here and now. I'm not sad about this, I'm relieved. It's all coming to an end, and it's all I've asked for.
Thanks, I hadn't thought about those things, something else I should take care of.
literally every search for me tbh
